decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That planning permission should be granted
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the wall hereby permitted shall match the ground floor front elevation brickwork of the main dwelling house.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - Ornamental trees and shrubs or a replacement hedge shall be planted along the front boundary of the property in the planting season immediately following the removal of the front hedge.

Condition : 6 - The wall hereby permitted shall not be erected until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before the wall hereby permitted is completed.
description: Erection of a 1 metre high boundary wall to front elevation, painting of front door (red) and front elevation white.
